messages:
Priya: Quick sync — PR 27391 (feature/auth-retry) is ready but blocked by failing integration tests. Can we coordinate merge timing? There's a maintenance window Tue 2026-03-24 09:00 UTC that should be avoided. Need 1 more approval + CI green. Can someone rebase + trigger rerun? :pray:

Liam: I can take the rebase in ~30m. What's flaky test name?

Priya: thanks. It's `auth_integration::session_refresh_flow`. Fail output:
```
E test failed: timeout waiting for oauth token refresh
2026-03-16 22:14:01 ERROR request timed out
```
Suspect race with token revocation mock.

Liam: ok I'll rebase and run locally. If it's the mock timing we can add a small sleep in the test or increase timeout.

Ruth: I'm +1 on the code changes but will not approve until CI passes and SRE confirms rollback plan. Can SRE confirm whether we can land before the maintenance window? @sre-oncall

sre-oncall: maintenance window Tue 09:00-11:00 UTC (DB schema migration). Recommend avoiding any non-critical deploys 2 hours before. If you need to land earlier, prefer a canary to dedicated region first. If rollback needed, tag the rollback runbook: runbook/rollback-v2 (link: https://go/runbook/rollback-v2)

Priya: Got it. Plan B: split the small DB migration out into a separate hotfix so the rest can land earlier. Would that help? @Liam

Liam: Yes, can split. I can open PR 27391.1 with the non-migration parts and land that pre-freeze after CI green. Then follow up with migration PR during maintenance window with oncall present.

CI Bot: build queued for PR 27391 (rebase in progress)

CI Bot: rerun started by @Liam — integration suite running

Priya: @Ruth thank you — once CI is green can you give the approval? I'll hold merge until you ack. 

Ruth: Will watch, aim to approve if canary looks fine. :eyes:

Priya: Appreciate — tagging this thread as final plan: rebase+split -> run CI -> land non-migration PR before Tue 07:00 UTC -> migration PR in maintenance window with oncall. I'll update PR description with timeline.

Liam: Rebase done, pushing tests now.

CI Bot: PR 27391 - integration passed ✅

Ruth: Approved. Land when ready. :thumbsup:

Priya: Landing now. Thanks everyone. :tada:
